model_inputs: complete PUBLIC64 manifest and strict basename prefixes
sealed28 linear point-query hypothesis captures derived at runtime
forbidden_inputs: PRIVATE observed-object labels or identity mapping
PRIVATE future action outcomes or canonical targets
information_role: Unknown-physics public-prefix posterior; model grid labels are hypotheses, never observed-object labels.
known_scope: Static ideal nine-point observations; no RGBD, causal dynamics or physical calibration.
barrier: All28 original linear capture hashes before first extraction; all64 prefix file hashes before first inference; all64x2 predictions/failures sealed before independent evaluation.
technical_failure_policy: Stop new launches, retain queue and drain in-flight; owned process-group wall/RSS cleanup, no retries.
numerical_failure_policy: Returned numerical failures retained and flagged separately; no drop/retry or pass-by-exit-code.
